name: Corona Imp
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes: crimson leathery skin, short curled black horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, bigger and fatter than other imps, its skin glowing gold-orange from inside like a furnace, a blazing double ring of white-hot embers circling its horns, heat haze around its whole body

poses.stand: hovering on spread bat wings, chest out, the double corona of embers blazing round its head
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: hovers, chest heaving, its whole body pulsing with gold heat, the corona turning round its horns

attack.action: spreads its arms and roars, blasting the double ring of embers outward in every direction, heat rippling off its body, then the corona sparks back

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
